_comment: Drupal sites whose events calendar is the fullcalendar_view module, read by mapsee_ingest_drupal_fullcalendar.py. One entry per site. calendar_url is the page carrying drupalSettings.fullCalendarView; detail_rewrite maps an event's calendar path to the page that says where it is; map_centres are the geolocation widget's default view (never a venue unless the node's street is that street); venues is the venue book (longest path prefix wins), used only when a page has neither its own point nor a street. street_pins is the street book: a pin and a name for a street a page prints without a point. area_streets are addresses of a whole open space that place nothing; blurb_start reads 'This program begins at <place>, <street>, <town>, <ST> <ZIP>' from the blurb and lets it beat the location field; cost_in_blurb lifts the blurb's own cost sentence to the price line when there is no price field; list_cap is the calendar's own cap on events listed, at which a read never counts as complete (lesson 7 in the adapter, OC Parks).

sources.name: Fairfax County, VA events calendar
sources._require_visible_date_why: Fairfax's template prints the date it means in .event_date.value; a page without one (Animal Services' Reading Tails, 2 of 151 on 2026-10-04: 'check the exact date and time in the registration link') carries only a placeholder startDate.

map_centres._why: data-centre-lat/lng on every page's geolocation map, measured 2026-10-04; it is the Government Center's own pin

promoters.promoter: Fairfax County Department of Family Services
Fairfax County Neighborhood and Community Services
Fairfax County Public Works and Environmental Services

sources._venues_why: The Park Authority's own location-node pins (geolocation data-lat/lng on its pages), read 2026-10-04 from 116 park event pages and 4 rec-centre location pages. Used only for a page that names no place: 1 of 116 park rows that day (Huntley Meadows). Census geocodes of the same streets sit a median 216 m (max 1,074 m, Lake Accotink) from these pins; 23 of 24 matched. rivebend is the calendar's own misspelling of riverbend.
sources._street_pins_why: Streets a page names WITHOUT a point that the US Census batch the sync geocodes with cannot place: on 2026-10-04 5 of 15 street-only rows (3 streets) got no match, and the one-line geocoder put the third on 6500 Franconia Rd, the wrong road. Each pin is OpenStreetMap's (via Geofabrik's Postpass, read 2026-10-05), matched on the normalised street with its house number.

sources.name: OC Parks events calendar (Orange County, CA)
sources._require_visible_date_why: Every one of 111 sampled pages (2026-10-11) shows 'Sat, November 7, 2026 2:30 pm - 5:00 pm PST' in .info-date-time__body, and all 111 agree with the calendar's own start and end.
sources._page_selectors_why:
The theme puts a block_content field-wysiwyg (an accessibility script) before the event, so the first .field-wysiwyg read 'Body' on 39 of 39 rows of the first run; the event's own body is the one inside
, and the related-event cards after
carry other events' bodies. 'address' is the location node's

: 'field-location' makes split_address take its 'Location'/'Address' labels for the venue. No page has a form block: the registration is the blurb's 'Learn more and register here' link (letsgooutside.org or lagunacanyon.org).
sources._cost_in_blurb_why: No page has a price field; 57 of 58 rows built on 2026-10-11 say their cost in a sentence of the blurb ('The program is free and parking is $3 per vehicle.'), and the cut that fits the sync's 800 characters took that sentence from 30 of them. Lifted word for word to the head, it survives on all 57.
sources._blurb_start_why: Laguna Canyon Foundation and Jr. Ranger pages put the start in the blurb: '*This program begins at Canyon View Park, 22144 Canyon Vistas, Aliso Viejo, CA 92656*', while the location field holds the park's address. On 2026-10-11, 20 of the 28 'This program begins/takes place at' sentences on 109 pages end in a street, and all 20 parse; the Aliso and Wood Canyons starts sit 3.1 to 5.0 km from that park's address, Laguna Coast's Willow Staging Area 3.2 km from its own.
sources._list_cap_why: drupalSettings lists exactly 500 events, newest node first (eid 43451 down to 40851, 2026-07-20 to 2026-12-16): the view's cap. On 2026-10-11 the deepest event still to come sat at list position 290, so nothing upcoming was cut, but a read at the cap can never prove an absence.

area_streets.name: Irvine Ranch Open Space
area_streets._why: The location field of every Irvine Ranch Open Space programme (60 of 152 rows in the 2026-10-11 window, by title; 45 pages read). OC Parks' own pin for it (node 76: 33.764933,-117.678412) is Black Star Canyon's gate. The 9 pages that say where they start name the Portola, Augustine, Baker Canyon, Creek, Hicks Haul Road, Weir (Outdoor Education Center) and Canyons staging areas, 2.6 to 11.2 km from that pin; none starts at it, not even 'Wilderness Access Day: Black Star Canyon' (Baker Canyon Staging Area).

sources._street_pins_why: Census batch, 2026-10-11, as the sync calls it: 7 of 21 streets these rows carry got no match (28373 Alicia Parkway among them, the street of 21 rows), and '10 Phillips St, Laguna Beach' matched Phillips Circle in Laguna Niguel, 10.1 km away. Park streets carry OC Parks' own location-node pin (geofield, read from each park page's drupalSettings), named by the node's title; Laguna Coast's node pin is the Big Bend Staging Area (10 m), 4.6 km from its address, so 18751 Laguna Canyon Road carries OSM's pin for the building at that address. Banner streets the Census cannot place carry OSM's (via Geofabrik's Postpass).
